source.label: MedCHI Connect 2026 · public programme and institutional locations

metricDefinitions.label: Authors
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct named authors of mapped programme contributions. Authors with multiple contributions are counted once in each displayed group of institutions.

metricDefinitions.label: Contributions
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct titles of mapped programme contributions associated with the displayed institutions.

metricDefinitions.label: Geographic precision
metricDefinitions.definition: Institutional city locations. These points do not identify homes, individual buildings or attendance. The individual branches for INAIL and the University of Campania remain unconfirmed.

caveats: Coverage includes 32 public-programme contributions with available affiliation data. It is not a complete list of speakers, attendees or every item in the programme.
Nearby institutions are clustered for readability. Click a cluster to zoom and separate its locations.

evidenceFlow.title: Public programme verification
evidenceFlow.detail: Names and contribution titles reconciled against the public conference programme on 26 November 2026. A spelling variation for Telmo Zarraonandía was reconciled manually with the institutional researcher page. The monument contribution uses the current public-programme title.

evidenceFlow.title: Institutional geography
evidenceFlow.detail: Affiliations supplied by the organisers were normalised to institutional names. City coordinates use GeoNames via ROR, with institutional branch checks for Belfast, Turin and Leganés. Leganés uses OpenStreetMap through Photon.
